fact: The November 2024 mutual evaluation report states that apart from some banks' own wallets only one company is authorised by COBAC as a payment service provider in Equatorial Guinea, and that it officially launched on 30 June 2023.
title: República de Guinea Ecuatorial: Medidas de lucha contra el blanqueo de capitales y la financiación del terrorismo, Informe de Evaluación Mutua
